description: Manage contacts and messages and read call history in CloudTalk.

cloudtalk_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in CloudTalk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, name, title, company, industry, website, address, city, state, zip, country.code, country.name, phones, emails, tags, customFields, favoriteUserId, source, createdAt, updatedAt, dashboardUrl

cloudtalk_new_incoming_call_trigger.description: Runs for each new inbound call in CloudTalk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, started_at, ended_at, recorded

cloudtalk_new_outgoing_call_trigger.description: Runs for each new outbound call in CloudTalk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, started_at, ended_at, recorded

cloudtalk_updated_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each updated contact in CloudTalk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, name, title, company, industry, website, address, city, state, zip, country.code, country.name, phones, emails, tags, customFields, favoriteUserId, source, createdAt, updatedAt, dashboardUrl
